label: Arts & Expression
scope_note: Creative expression and its traditions: literature, music, visual arts, performance, film, architecture and design.

label: Literature
scope_note: Verbal art, written and oral, in every language.

label: Poetry
scope_note: Verse in its many forms and traditions.

label: Prose fiction
scope_note: Novels, short stories and other narrative prose.

label: Epic and oral literature
scope_note: Epics and other long narrative works, often first composed and performed orally, such as the Epic of Gilgamesh, the Mahabharata, the Epic of Sundiata, the Popol Vuh and the Book of Dede Korkut.

label: Essays and literary nonfiction
scope_note: Essays, memoirs, travel writing and other literary nonfiction.

label: Children's literature
scope_note: Literature written or told for children.

label: Comics and graphic narrative
scope_note: Stories told in sequences of images and words: comics, manga, bandes dessinées, graphic novels.

label: Literary theory and criticism
scope_note: Ways of reading, interpreting and evaluating literature.

label: Music
scope_note: Organized sound in all its traditions and uses.

label: Music theory and composition
scope_note: How music is structured and made: pitch, rhythm, harmony, form, and the theories of different traditions.

label: Musical instruments
scope_note: Instruments of every tradition and how they produce sound.

label: Art music traditions
scope_note: Learned, formally transmitted music traditions set side by side — among them Arabic maqam, Carnatic, Chinese, gamelan, Hindustani, Japanese, Persian and European classical music.

label: Folk and traditional music
scope_note: Music passed on within communities, often orally.

label: Popular music
scope_note: Commercially spread music genres, such as jazz, rock, hip hop, reggae, Afrobeats, K-pop and electronic dance music.

label: Sacred and devotional music
scope_note: Music of worship and devotion across traditions.

label: Ethnomusicology
scope_note: Music studied in its social and cultural context.

label: Visual arts
scope_note: Art made primarily to be seen.

label: Painting
scope_note: Painting in its media and traditions.

label: Drawing and printmaking
scope_note: Drawing, and the making of images from blocks, plates and screens.

label: Sculpture
scope_note: Three-dimensional art in stone, wood, metal, clay and other materials.

label: Photography
scope_note: Making images with light-sensitive materials and sensors, as art, record and communication.

label: Calligraphy
scope_note: The art of beautiful writing, in scripts such as Arabic, Chinese, Latin, Devanagari and Ottoman Turkish.

label: Textile arts
scope_note: Weaving, embroidery, knotting, dyeing, quilting and other arts of fibre and cloth.

label: Ceramics and pottery
scope_note: Objects of fired clay, useful and decorative.

label: Decorative arts and crafts
scope_note: Art in useful objects: metalwork, woodwork, glass, lacquer, jewellery, furniture.

label: Rock art
scope_note: Images painted, drawn or carved on rock, from the Palaeolithic to the present, found on every inhabited continent.

label: Art history and criticism
scope_note: The history and interpretation of art.

label: Performing arts
scope_note: Arts presented live by performers.

label: Theatre and drama
scope_note: Drama performed live, in forms such as Sanskrit drama, Noh and Kabuki, Peking opera, European theatre and contemporary theatre.

label: Dance
scope_note: Dance in its social, ritual and artistic forms.

label: Puppetry
scope_note: Theatre with puppets, including shadow theatres such as wayang kulit and Karagöz.

label: Opera and music theatre
scope_note: Staged drama carried by music.

label: Film and moving image
scope_note: Cinema, animation and other moving-image arts.

label: Animation
scope_note: Moving images made from drawings, models or computer graphics.

label: Documentary film
scope_note: Nonfiction film.

label: Architecture
scope_note: Designing buildings and spaces, across traditions.

label: Vernacular architecture
scope_note: Traditional building by communities using local materials and knowledge.

label: Gardens and landscape design
scope_note: Designing gardens, parks and landscapes.

label: Urban planning and design
scope_note: Planning and designing towns and cities.

label: Design
scope_note: Shaping objects, images and systems for use and meaning.

label: Graphic design
scope_note: Visual communication with type, image and layout.

label: Industrial design
scope_note: Designing manufactured products.

label: Fashion design
scope_note: Designing clothing and accessories.

label: Interaction design
scope_note: Designing how people interact with digital products and services.
